record.final_answer:
Total shipping cost for October: **$58.01** across 6 orders.

One thing you should know: run against the default rate card, `scripts/cost.sh` exits 1 with `no rate for zone "north" (order A-1001)`. The cause is that `data/zone-rates.tsv` has CRLF line endings, so awk reads the zone column as `north\r` and no zone ever matches. The orders file is LF, so only the rate card is affected.

Since you asked me not to touch either file, I passed the script an LF-normalized copy of the rate card as its second argument (`/tmp/hermes/cache/scratch/zone-rates.tsv`) — the script already supports that. `git status` is clean; both files' contents are untouched.

I cross-checked the total independently in Python with exact decimal arithmetic and got the same $58.01. Fixing this permanently is a one-line change in the script (strip `\r` when reading the rate card) or in the logistics team's export — say the word and I'll do the script side.
